subject: Security discovery: scope, evidence needs, and next steps (SOC 2 / retention / pen-test)
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Rebecca Li <rebecca.li@alpha-fin.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security discovery: scope, evidence needs, and next steps (SOC 2 / retention / pen-test)

Hi Rebecca — thanks again for the demo and for walking us through Alpha Financial's compliance bar earlier today. Quick recap from our side + proposed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks.

Summary of key pain points you called out:
- SOC 2 / independent attestation required for vendors providing inference.
- Audit-log retention: legal requires 24 months of immutable audit logs (syslog and request traces).
- Evidence for data handling: DPA clauses and proof of encryption at rest (KMS integration), key custody and rotation cadence.
- Pen test: customer-led penetration test window preferred; Alpha needs vendor coordination and a scope doc.
- Data residency: primary data in us-east-1, occasional EU reads for a small subset.

What Redwood will deliver (next 7–14 business days):
1) Evidence catalog (attached) — initial mapping between Alpha asks and Redwood artifacts (SOC 2 controls, config screenshots, retention config, sample logs).
2) Control mapping worksheet for the DPA and for SOC 2 controls — Aditya will own pulling the SOC 2 report excerpts and control IDs.
3) Pen-test coordination plan and suggested scope for Alpha's security team — Neha will propose a 2-week window and responsible contacts.
4) Retention architecture diagram + sample log export (how audit logs are stored and the retention/immutable settings).

Asks from Alpha (what we need from you):
- Confirm the scope of the pen test (external-only vs authenticated credentialed tests) and any blackout windows.
- Share Alpha's vendor risk template (if you have one) — we can fill it out.
- Any specific clause language for the DPA you want Redwood to pre-sign or review.

Proposed timeline:
- 2026-01-15: Redwood sends evidence catalog v1 + control mapping (Aditya).
- 2026-01-18–22: Technical deep-dive (Neha + infra) with Alpha security to walk artifacts and logs.
- 2026-01-26: Finalize pen-test window and DPA redline plan.

Attachments: redwood-evidence-catalog-v1.xlsx (artifact index, initial owner suggestions)

If that matches what you heard on your side, I’ll lock in owners and dates today.

Thanks — Michael
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0184

From: Rebecca Li <rebecca.li@alpha-fin.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@alpha-fin.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery: scope, evidence needs, and next steps (SOC 2 / retention / pen-test)

Michael — thanks for the clear recap. That aligns well. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Pen-test: we prefer a credentialed test that includes both external network and authenticated app-layer checks; we can provide a service account (read-only) for the duration. Can you confirm Redwood is comfortable with that and will provide a contact for the test engineers?
2) Encryption at rest: we need a KMS diagram showing whether keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed and the rotation schedule. Also a short attestation of FIPS 140-2 compliance for the HSM if you use one.
3) Logs: retention of 24 months is firm; we also need an export process (S3 export or syslog forwarding) with proof that exported logs preserve original timestamp and hashes (integrity).

Attached our vendor risk template to speed up intake: Alpha-risk-template.docx.

Proposed deep-dive: 2026-01-19 10:00–11:00 PT with our security + infra (we can shift if needed).

One small ask on the DPA: our legal prefers to insert a clause that specifies incident notification timelines (48 hours initial notice). We can share redline language once we have the proof artifacts.

Best,
Rebecca Li
Security Program Manager — Vendor Risk | Alpha Financial
rebecca.li@alpha-fin.com

- Neha Kapoor: Pen-test coordination & scope draft. Identify test POC, provide contact info and proposed test window (we should target 2026-01-26 to 2026-02-09 as a candidate). Deliverable: pen-test scope doc + contact by 2026-01-15.
- Lauren Bishop: Retention + logs diagram + sample export. Deliverable: retention architecture diagram + sample export (redacted) by 2026-01-15.
- Michael: DPA redline coordination and legal touchpoint; I’ll pull in Legal if we hit pushback on the incident-notice clause.

I’ve attached a quick ownership map to help with handoffs: evidence-ownership-map.csv
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-7890

Notes for artifacts: when assembling logs please include (a) ingestion timestamps, (b) request-id correlation across frontend -> inference runtime -> storage, and (c) an example of the immutable retention flag/manifest. We should not include raw customer data; redact any PII.

Please reply-all with any blockers; Aditya/Neha/Lauren assume responsibility to hit the 01/15 delivery.

Thanks — Michael
